entities.summary: Aleksandr Mikhalovich Buturlin is a Russian professional ice hockey winger who played with HC Spartak Moscow in the Kontinental Hockey League during the 2010–11 KHL season. He was selected by the Montreal Canadiens in the second round of the 1999 NHL Entry Draft.
